site.name: Wellmill, LLC dba Vitamix Laboratories
site.address: 106 Lake Ave S Suite 4-5, Nesconset, NY

observations.title: Inadequate hazard analysis and HACCP plan
observations.summary: FDA found the firm did not conduct an adequate hazard analysis or maintain a HACCP plan for its juice products, failing to identify biological and physical hazards introduced during non‑aseptic blending and glass bottling.

observations.title: Failure to achieve required 5‑log pathogen reduction
observations.summary: The firm blends and fills juice at ambient temperature without applying a validated process that achieves the required 5‑log reduction of pertinent pathogens, as mandated by 21 CFR 120.24(a).

observations.title: Non‑compliance with single‑facility requirement
observations.summary: FDA determined the firm has not demonstrated compliance with the single‑facility requirement that the 5‑log pathogen reduction and final product packaging occur within one CGMP‑compliant facility.
